newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cydsa 1996 net falls after Serfin losses.
newsitem.headline: Cydsa 1996 net falls after Serfin losses.

text.p: Mexican textile and chemical group Cydsa's 1996 net earnings were pared after incorporating its stake in the Grupo Financiero Serfin SA de CV financial group, the company said in recent statement.
Cydsa posted 1996 net consolidated earnings of 460 million pesos on March 6, but this figure fell to 345 million pesos after it incorporated losses by Serfin during Q4 1996, the statement added.
Operating earnings were nonetheless unchanged at 765 million pesos as the losses posted by Serfin were non-cash items, Cydsa added.

"It is important to mention that the effect derived from a share in Serfin's earnings and the stock dilution by that company are non-cash charges against earnings that do not represent a cash outflow," the Cydsa statement said.
